text: Lice on poultry do not suck blood — they feed on dry skin scales, feathers, and scabs, and their entire life cycle happens on the chicken (they cannot spread to humans). Eggs stick to feathers, especially around the vent, causing irritation, feather loss, and scabbing there. Treat with Carbaryl; since the lice life cycle is about 2 weeks, repeat treatment every 2 weeks as needed.
